description: This file defines the FormEditor class, which serializes and deserializes Form objects for use in Spring forms, including retrieval by ID and UUID.

classes.name: FormEditor
classes.description: A property editor for Form objects, enabling serialization/deserialization and retrieval by ID or UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Form object by its internal ID using the FormService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Form object by its UUID using the FormService.
